title: Upper-tail incomplete gamma for a <= 20 runs uncontracted Modified Lentz with TINY=1e-30, and poisson_mass switches at <= 1.1
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, all upper-tail incomplete-gamma calls with a <= 20.0 (both a < 1.0, x >= 1.1 and 1.0 < a <= 20.0, x > a outside finite sums) evaluate the uncontracted Legendre continued fraction using Thompson-Barnett Modified Lentz from b_0 = 0 (f = c = TINY, d = 0.0) with Numerical Recipes TINY = 1.0e-30 (0x39b08b2a2c280291), storing each arithmetic operation to binary64 at x87 PC64, stopping at k > 0 && del == 1.0, and multiplying S(pm * f) directly without factoring a out of the fraction. At k = 0, c_0 = S(x + S(a / TINY)) rounds a * 10^30 + x into binary64, so changing TINY to 1e-50 or 1e-100 breaks about half of 10,000 tested rows. In poisson_mass(a, x), Excel switches between the compensated exponential and Loader's saddle-point expansion inclusively at x <= 1.1 || a <= 1.1 (0x3ff199999999999a, verified by single-bit bisection at 1.1 vs next_up(1.1)). POISSON(x, mean, cum) and POISSON.DIST(x, mean, cum) match across all 278 paired probes, and POISSON.DIST(k, m, TRUE) equals CHIDIST(2*m, 2*(k+1)) and CHISQ.DIST.RT(2*m, 2*(k+1)). See https://github.com/DnaCalc/DnaCalc/blob/344d70dcea3ea77cbbeee1595f96694630a9610a/docs/articles/last-bit-gamma.md.
basis: Measured across cb8's 1,325 live Excel 16.0.20527 calls and frozen_cb8_predictions.jsonl (560 of 560 unseen forward calls across 6 functions matched with 0 ULP max error; 599 of 640 overall), plus nx7's frozen_nx7_proof2_pred.jsonl (50 of 50 on the 1.1 inclusive boundary). On full witness banks after nx7, POISSON reached 1,556 of 1,560, POISSON.DIST 49,707 of 49,710 decoded (0 cumulative CF/asymp/Temme misses), CHIDIST 3,241 of 3,241, and CHISQ.DIST.RT 2,858 of 2,859.
inferred: That Excel executes this exact Modified Lentz recurrence and TINY constant is inferred from matching 10,000 of 10,000 offline controls, targeted del==1.0 vs nf==f tie-breakers (2 of 2), and 560 of 560 prospective forward holdouts.
